notes.title: Update 1.4: Star
notes.notes:
[h1]Hello divine beings,[/h1]

Today we are releasing the third major update to Gods Against Machines nicknamed "[b]Star[/b]".

In this update, our focus is on replayability. For this reason, we are introducing star signs! When starting a new game, you will now be able to choose one of 12 star signs. Each one influences the core rules of the game in a unique (and often challenging) way.

[h1]Star signs[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43691737/16c39a2c6620720c8899b49a7353ebbaea28a8ef.png[/img]

At the beginning, you will only be able to pick one of four star signs - or play without one, thus using the original rules of the game.[b] To unlock the remaining eight star signs you will have to beat the regular campaign (level 40) on various difficulties using any star sign.[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43691737/7113dccc96286d00c34c98f29c37e1e44d8079a8.png[/img]

Our goal with star signs is to [b]challenge your usual strategies[/b] or introduce twists to the usual rules of the game. This should force you to[b] use spells you wouldn't otherwise use[/b], or stop relying on spells that normally would be the staple of your build. Some star signs might actually make the game [b]easier with the right strategy[/b]. Others will make the game [b]nearly impossible[/b] and require deep knowledge of the game to even beat the regular campaign.

So what do some star signs do? Let's look at one of our favorites - [b]Libra[/b]:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43691737/e96a862fbfe58f8a5e46255832455bd822c9bf73.png[/img]

When using this star sign, corruption is your friend! You get more rewards the more corruption spreads across the region. Sounds easy right? But beware, if the total world corruption reaches 100% you will still lose the game, so act accordingly.

Another star sign that we really like is [b]Leo [/b]- this one will test your skills to the limit!

[i][b]Leo [/b]- Enemy damage and hitpoints are doubled but your shard, essence and fate charm rewards for clearing regions are doubled as well.[/i]

It will require careful planning and some luck to beat the game with this star sign. But doing so will definitely be an achievement worth celebrating.

[h1]New achievements[/h1]

Speaking of achievements - each star sign comes with a [b]new achievement[/b]! The criteria for earning them are simple. Just beat the regular campaign using the given star sign on the required difficulty and you will earn it. Can you get all twelve?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43691737/5a12ceceaf967ebe42fa58d085b305a764e3286b.png[/img]

[h1]Conclusion[/h1]

Hopefully you will enjoy this update! While it seems like a small one, we actually had to touch almost all parts of the game to allow for such drastic changes to some of the core rules. If you encounter issues, please report them so we can fix them as soon as possible. Thank you!

Peter

notes.title: Patch 1.34
notes.notes:
[h1]Patch 1.34[/h1]

[h2]General[/h2]

[list]
[*] When rerolling new spells or blessings, discarded choices will get much lower priority on the next rolls (this effectively makes marks of fate stronger). Note: does not work for other reward types
[*] The spawn points of player and enemy bases are now a little bit closer than before - previously we separated both factions as much as possible, but this made building-heavy builds too slow or useless due to the large distance between bases and it also reduced the danger coming from enemy artillery turrets too much
[/list]

[h2]New spell abilities and blessings[/h2]

[list]
[*] [b]Power overwhelming[/b] - chance to temporarily increase the damage of your spells
[*] [b]Quick energy[/b] - chance to temporarily decrease the cooldown of your spells
[*] [b]Controlled force[/b] - same effect as [b]Power Infusion[/b] (chance to increase damage) but also makes the spell move in the same direction always
[*] [b]Charged arrow[/b] - blessing that increases critical strike chance (stronger version of [b]Blazing arrow[/b])
[/list]

[h2]Spells[/h2]

[list]
[*] [b]Ice Wall[/b] - changed [b]Power Infusion[/b] into [b]Controlled force[/b] and increased the base damage of the spell by 10%
[*] [b]Flame sword[/b] - slightly reduced the damage at higher levels (about 5% reduction)
[*] [b]Fireball[/b], Ice Shard and Rock Spike had their high-level damage reduced very slightly (about 5% reduction)
[*] [b]Storm Pillar[/b] - maximum range increased by 10% to allow offensive usage of this building
[*] [b]Thunderstorm [/b]- greatly increased the chance of casting Tornadoes when the "cast spell" upgrade is activated
[*] [b]Furnace, Healing Waters[/b] - added [b]Quick energy[/b] ability that temporarily decreases cooldown of spells (must be activated)
[*] [b]Spike field, Rejuvenation, Healing Waters[/b] - added [b]Power overwhelming[/b] ability that temporarily increases damage of spells (must be activated)
[*] [b]Spike field[/b] - increased the damage by 10%
[*] [b]Water shield[/b] - added the ability to add a temporary blessing called [b]Healing Waters[/b] that increases the corruption resistance (must be activated)
[*] [b]Time shift[/b] - added the ability to add a temporary blessing called [b]Charged arrow[/b] that increases the critical strike chance (must be activated)
[*] [b]Rain Of Fire, Blizzard[/b] - added the [b]Power Infusion[/b] ability (must be activated), this ability transfers to spells cast by these ([b]Fireball[/b],[b] Ice Shard[/b])
[*] [b]Whirlpool [/b]- add the ability to trigger the [b]Sacred Hammer[/b] blessing (must be activated)
[*] [b]Fire eater[/b] - added the ability to spawn a [b]Fire Phoenix[/b] (must be activated)
[/list]

[h2]Balance[/h2]

[list]
[*] [b]Rising Tide[/b] - capped the height of water but introduced a 300% buff to drowning damage when water is at max height. This means that in some rare cases, enemy bases cannot be fully drowned, but when maximum height is reached the damage will overwhelm enemies quickly even on highest difficulty
[*] [b]Eternal flame[/b] - increased the damage of the blessing at higher levels considerably (30%) to make it more in line with the Rising Tide changes
[*] Webbed menace - the damage and hitpoints of spider minions has been reduced by 20% on average due to them being way too strong when fully upgraded even on the highest difficulty
[*] [b]Mana crystals[/b] - slightly decreased their damage and hitpoints (roughly 10% reduction)
[*] [b]Enemy reinforcement[/b] events that summon buildings have been strenghtened at higher levels to give enemies more chance to recover from base destruction at higher difficulties
[*] Enemy builder drones had their range increased by 20%
[*] Increased alien terraformer corruption output by 10%
[*] Enemy laser turrets had their damage increased by 10%
[*] The blessings [b]Servants sacrifice and Servants vengeance[/b] were too strong for minion heavy builds so their power has been reduced by 25-30% (these are the blessings that remove corruption or resources when your minions die) - they are still quite strong but not as broken as before
[*] The blessing [b]Protectors of nature[/b] was too weak so it's power has been increased by 35% (this blessing clears corruption when you bargain with powerful spirits)
[/list]

[h2]Bugfixes[/h2]

[list]
[*] [b]Gift of purity[/b] - fixed the description and fixed a bug that caused it to calculate the amount of corruption to cleanse incorrectly
[*] Reduced the volume of some sound effects to make them less annoying ([b]Ice wall[/b], spider death)
[*] [b]Empower [/b]spell can now be cast on water
[*] Fixed a bug that caused units to stop attacking when there was too many of them
[/list]

notes.title: Update 1.3: Gaia
notes.notes:
[h1]Hello divine beings,[/h1]

Today we are releasing the second major update to Gods Against Machines nicknamed "[b]Gaia[/b]".

In this update, you can look forward to a new Gaia power, optional mission objectives and new rewards for completing them - [b]Gaia's Gifts and Wonders[/b]! There are also several smaller changes, such as more control over game scaling in EASY difficulty, as well as tons of fixes and small improvements, and of course balance changes.

[h1]New Gaia power[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43691737/d58ef7bd21dc9e7961a41e86d91d147972df1c5e.png[/img]

We have added a new baseline (always active) Gaia power - [b]Wonders Of Nature[/b]!

By upgrading this power, you will be able to encounter [b]optional objectives[/b] (more on this below) in missions more often and receive better rewards for completing them. It will also allow you to use [b]wonders [/b]more often and gain access to more powerful wonders. But what are these wonders and what are the optional objectives? Read on to learn more!

[h1]Optional objectives[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43691737/ad912f64d2a5124938c89bd3a02b41f1e7e55dcb.png[/img]

In some regions, you will have the opportunity to complete an optional objective. These make it [b]more difficult to defeat the enemy[/b] by requiring you to play a certain way - remove a certain amount of corruption, use only certain types of spells, not use miracles, etc. Some objectives even have a time limit - for example, you have to kill bosses fast enough to complete them. If you can't, don't worry - nothing bad will happen, but you will miss out on [b]powerful rewards that you can't get any other way![/b] Fortunatelly you can see what kind of objectives (if any) will be active in the available regions:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43691737/c043a2bcc3dd1490ca7caa9b1b4864972008eb70.png[/img]

Some optional objectives may be very easy because your build is very good at solving that particular challenge, while others may be nearly impossible. The [b]choice[/b] of which goals to attempt is entirely up to you! 

But what about the rewards? Let's take a look at what [b]Gaia's gifts[/b] and [b]wonders [/b]are:

[h1]Gaia's gifts[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43691737/9fcf729952185dfae1bf545d6bf4d888acfc3fd1.png[/img]

Gift's are rewards that are used [b]immediatelly[/b] when you pick them up. When you complete an optional objective, there will always be at least one gift to select among the options. There are eight different gifts in the game - here is an example of three of them:

[list]
[*] [b]Gift of power[/b] - Earn maximum number of rewards for winning this region regardless of corruption.
[*] [b]Gift of clarity[/b]- Corruption in this region won't be added to world corruption.
[*] [b]Gift of fate[/b] - Earn 3 fate charms.
[/list]

[h1]Gaia's wonders[/h1]

[b]Wonders are a completely new mechanic[/b] which we are introducing in this patch. They are tokens that you can use to request help from Gaia at any time during a region battle. This should allow you to have more control over the battle and tackle extremely hard challenges more easily. You can gather wonders in advance and then use them at the right time to overcome even the strongest of foes.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43691737/2712883c320140232eccef393d5b5d30df5bbfce.png[/img]

The [b]Wonders Of Nature[/b] Gaia power is relatively weak at first, but once you spend a good amount of essences to upgrade it you will be able to get many wonders and use them as often as you like!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43691737/08be04e1b5a88018da25265afc5611871548f7ac.png[/img]

There are six different wonders in the game and each of them comes in two flavors: normal and greater. [b]The greater wonder has a much stronger effect[/b] than the normal one. For example:

[list]
[*] [b]Wonder of fire[/b] - Destroy all small enemy military units.
[*] [b]Great wonder of fire[/b] - Destroy all small enemy military units as well as military producing buildings.
[/list]

[h1]Experiment in EASY difficulty[/h1]

We have also added a small feature that has been requested on our forums - the ability to[b] change how enemy power scales[/b] in EASY difficulty. You can now reduce or increase their damage and hitpoints as well as the amount of resources they have so that you can test your powers or experiment with crazy builds!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43691737/7ff98d93f233e782d5150d4d53774b611aa60c03.png[/img]

[h1]New achievements[/h1]

With new features come [b]new achievements![/b] We did not want to make them too grindy, so you can get all on NORMAL difficulty, but it will still require you to challenge yourself. Can you earn all three?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43691737/98b2b964e4c62395eb541d69803246fe1ec0c66e.png[/img]

[h1]Other improvements[/h1]

As always, there is a lot of small fixes and improvements in this patch. Here is a list of some of them:

[list]
[*] [b]Promised power[/b] blessing now gives twice as many shards than before (shards for bargaining with powerful spirits)
[*] Fixed a bug that caused the loot chance to be displayed incorrectly in the stats window
[*] Increased the amount of shards that can be obtained in a single region (from drones) to 6 (was 4) before diminishing returns kick in
[*] Fixed a bug that caused only 1 mark of fate to be rewarded for completing a region even though 2 (or more) should have been awarded
[*] Fixed a few bugs in descriptions of spells
[/list]

[h1]Conclusion[/h1]

Hopefully you will enjoy this update! We have more things in store for future. Please keep the feedback coming, we read our forums regularly and take everything you say seriously!

Peter

notes.title: Update 1.2: Fate
notes.notes:
[h2]Hello divine beings,[/h2]

Today we are releasing the first major update to Gods Against Machines nicknamed [b]"Fate"[/b].

As promised in our roadmap, we will be doing regular updates during the next couple of months. In the [b]"Fate"[/b] update, you can look forward to a ton of new content, including new difficulty settings, new mechanics and currencies as well as several quality of life improvements and balance changes.

[h2]New difficulty settings[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43691737/37eb716a0aaaf3e7ec70b8933ea72e4d5edb9d3f.png[/img]

We want to make sure that everyone can play [b]Gods Against Machines[/b] and have a balanced and enjoyable experience. We have seen some players breeze through the Void Realm on their second or third try, as well as players who have struggled with some of the mechanics and found it difficult to complete the regular campaign. While we made many balance changes to address issues such as weak (or too strong) spells or added more ways to overcome some mechanics, we saw that a much more complex solution was needed to ensure a fun experience for everyone. In the [b]"Fate"[/b] update, when you start a new game, you will have the option to choose one of four difficulty settings:

[h2]Difficulty: Normal[/h2]

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43691737/723d1c255d0c7c737d47f6de9e7987b744f8a947.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43691737/f3666306e44fe3fe49e748da8150710d0f1a7d24.png[/img][/url]

This is the [b]regular gameplay experience[/b] you know and it is also the default difficulty of the game.

[h2]Difficulty: Easy[/h2]

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43691737/a96a3fefe21a56dfae1cb44aba2b4e0c06aec7d8.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43691737/5f270b9bafd36ca2d69074873cf22af0d8c47b62.png[/img][/url]

[b]In this difficulty (nicknamed "Sandbox mode") we aim to give players much more freedom to have fun and experiment with weird builds.[/b] The most important changes compared to Normal difficulty are the following:

[list]
[*] Players can reroll rewards an unlimited number of times
[*] Enemy strength is reduced (~20% reduction)
[*] Amount of Power shards is increased
[/list]

To preserve the value of achievements we decided to disable earning them in this difficulty. This also means that it is not possible to earn Essences of Life or use Transmutation.

[h2]Difficulty: Hard[/h2]

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43691737/50f086e8a38ce47d79948a2fb50c508c04205bc8.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43691737/e0cc94ddf16a570ba292d2698bac73329d2d7632.png[/img][/url]

[b]This difficulty features greatly increased challenge.[/b] You will have to beat level 40 in Normal difficulty to access Hard. The major changes compared to Normal difficulty are:

[list]
[*] Enemy strength is increased (~40% increase)
[*] Number of rewards is slightly reduced
[*] Amount of Essences of life gained is increased
[/list]

To make things more interesting, additional machine-strenghtening curses are active. Additionally, new features are available: [b]Marks of Fate[/b] and [b]Twists of Fate[/b] (more on those bellow)

[h2]Difficulty: Brutal[/h2]

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43691737/01ecf60fab2153eacd89abc12cd1f8c635f57eac.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43691737/98cbed3ab2af6fa43b745d17ac2d6859130bb2d5.png[/img][/url]

[b]This is for players who want an extreme challenge[/b]. You will have to beat level 40 in Hard difficulty to access Brutal. This difficulty is very similar to Hard just taken to yet another level:

[list]
[*] Enemy strength is increased further (~80% increase)
[*] Amount of rewards is greatly reduced
[*] Amount of Essences of life gained is greatly increased
[/list]

Of course, both [b]Marks of Fate[/b] and [b]Twists of Fate[/b] are available in this difficulty too.

[h2]New currency: Mark of Fate[/h2]

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43691737/d6d04f09f02f999667f4eefe6d34013fcf51a5c8.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43691737/1d09e459fa4331db93997ffc3d522dc2b6789fb2.png[/img][/url]

When playing in Hard or Brutal difficulty, you will be able to earn a new currency: [b]Marks Of Fate[/b].

These tokens will allow you to[b] reroll most types of rewards[/b]. The most important exceptions are Gaia powers and Twists of Fate. In cases where there are rerolls allowed normally (such as when picking your first non-basic spell) these rerolls will be used first and only after you use all of them up the marks of fate will be used next.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43691737/1fbe42b66c45bc24603413480a24ba7f3cfa4b1d.png[/img]

[h2]New mechanic: Twist of Fate[/h2]

When playing in [b]Hard[/b] or [b]Brutal [/b]difficulty, additional machine strenghtening curses are active. To combat them, you will be able to choose one [b]Twist of Fate[/b] at the beginning of the game, and one more after you defeat level 30 or higher for the first time. This blessing will [b]fully negate[/b] one of the machine strenghtening curses. It is not possible to reroll these, so choose wisely! Bellow is a list of all the curses. In Brutal difficulty, most (but not all!) curses are even stronger.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43691737/0ccaa732cac902b059b11866a5c3361fb4f3f0d7.png[/img]

[h2]New feature: Machine strenghtening curses[/h2]

(Only active in Hard or Brutal difficulty)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43691737/ddcf9a285924e5410c181687059fafd0f22c94f8.png[/img]

[list]
[*] [b]Fractured crystals[/b] - The presence of the machines causes Gaia's mana crystals to fracture. This reduces their mana output
[*] [b]Self-destruct drones[/b] - Evacuation drones have a chance of self-destructing and when that happens you will not receive anything from them
[*] [b]Disrupted atmosphere[/b] - Machines are disrupting the world's atmosphere, causing more extreme weather
[*] [b]Hardened protocol[/b] - Spirits will be able to lure out machine commanders less often
[*] [b]Tactical ambush[/b] - There is a chance machines will send an additional commander against you after 60 seconds in a region
[*] [b]Advanced targeting[/b] - Machines use advanced targeting protocols and their attacks can now crit
[*] [b]Narrow choices[/b] - You are not in tune with the threads of fate. The number of reward choices is reduced to 2
[/list]

[h2]More achievements[/h2]

We have added 19 new achievements for you to earn! There are now 5 new achievements for progressing through Normal, Hard and Brutal difficulties as well as 4 new achievements for beating additional challenges in Hard and Brutal difficulties.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43691737/7371a0f9cbfa7e1ea763e5e7b14490c5ab21735c.png[/img]

[h2]New spell abilities[/h2]

Many spells got additional abilities:

[list]
[*] [b]Vortex[/b] - Added the fact that it can be used in antimagic zones.
[*] [b]Meteor Storm[/b] - Added the ability to summon Fire Trolls when cast (needs to be unlocked).
[*] [b]Molten Core[/b] - Added the ability to be cast in antimagic zones (needs to be unlocked).
[*] [b]Fire Eater[/b] - added the ability to cleanse corruption (needs to be unlocked)
[*] [b]Water Shield[/b] - added the ability to cleanse corruption (needs to be unlocked)
[*] [b]Call spirit[/b] - added the ability to summon additional units (Crocodiles), needs to be unlocked
[*] [b]Vortex, Healing Waters and Furnace[/b] - added the ability to instantly kill lesser units (needs to be unlocked)
[*] [b]Shatter[/b] - mana cost increased to 400 (was 300) and reduced the number of units summoned
[*] [b]Call of the sea[/b] - added the ability for reducing the cooldown of the spell further (needs to be unlocked)
[*] [b]Nature's call and Sacred hammer[/b] - added the ability to heal friendly units and buildings (needs to be unlocked)
[*] [b]Combustion[/b] - added the ability to summon Immortal Phoenix (needs to be unlocked)
[*] [b]Rain of fire[/b] - added the ability to remove resources from the enemy (needs to be unlocked)
[/list]

[h2]New blessings[/h2]

To give more depth to the passive abilities of Azzinoth and Nadea, we added additional blessings:

[list]
[*] [b]Burning Hell[/b] - Your Eternal Flame burning damage can now crit. At level two, it is also affected by fire damage modifiers
[*] [b]Tsunami[/b] - Your Rising tide drowning damage can now crit. At level two, it is affected by water damage modifiers
[/list]

[h2]Zafira overhaul[/h2]

We heard your complains about Zafira. Her powers felt weak sometimes and her AOE damage was lacking. To address these issues we decided to change her passive power a bit and introduce a completely new mechanic for her to help with AOE damage:

Passive power update:

[b]Eye of the storm[/b] - Your critical strike chance is increased by <color=#CBB299>{0}%</color> when below 50% mana and by half that amount when above 50% mana

New mechanic that is now baseline for many Lightning strike and unlockable for several other wind element spells:

[b]Unstable current[/b] - Unstable current hits nearby random targets for a large amount of cast spell damage. This effect has a chance to trigger equal to your current critical strike chance (at most 70%)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43691737/3d1db9d2f465010676434eb83bef53642695a760.png[/img]

[h2]More reward types[/h2]

To give players more choices when picking rewards, passive rewards have been split by element and had diminishing returns added.

[h2]Quality of life[/h2]

[list]
[*] It is now possible to open the spellbook/blessings/menu and queue spells for casting during pause (time freeze)
[*] Added setting to disable automatic camera pan during boss fights and tutorials.
[*] Added setting to completely disable joystick/controller.
[*] Added setting to disable autocast for basic spell
[*] Added the ability to automatically cast your basic spell (Fireball etc.) on a spot on the ground or unit/building
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43691737/08e1556bb9cfa48bf7e40ebfa9ed36dc93d272fd.png[/img]

[h2]Bugfixes[/h2]

The amount of small fixes is way too large to list them all, but here is a brief list of the most important ones:

[list]
[*] Reward distribution has been improved to offer new spells and blessings even much deeper into the campaign
[*] Improved controller handling and fixing some controller-specific bugs like lingering Info panel
[*] Spell autocast settings is now properly saved between play sessions
[*] Improved the targeting of spells around Antimagic zones or for targets under water
[*] Fixed several cases of spells not scaling summoned units properly
[/list]

[h2]Conclusion[/h2]

Hopefully you will enjoy this update! We have more things in store for future. Please keep the feedback coming, we read our forums regularly and take everything you say seriously!

Peter

notes.title: Update to version 1.10
notes.notes:
[h1]Update to version 1.10[/h1]

[h2]Bug fixes[/h2]

[list]
[*] Fixed a bug that could cause players to lose essence gained at the end of a campaign or [b]Void Realm[/b] if they quit the game immediately afterwards
[*] Fixed a bug that caused [b]Fury of the Earth[/b] to be triggered forever when no mana crystal was active and auto-casting was enabled for spells that trigger Fury of the Earth
[*] Fixed a bug where [b]Shards of Fortune[/b] would not trigger when a mana crystal was destroyed with the Shatter spell
[*] Fixed a bug that could cause the game to stop sending reinforcements to either side under rare circumstances
[*] [b]Confuse [/b]spell will now correctly confuse all flying units in range instead of just those near where it was cast
[*] Spell perks that trigger the [b]Sacred Hammer[/b] (free cast) will now show how the chance to trigger improves when upgraded
[*] [b]Timeshift [/b]spell now uses the correct icons for the Manipulate Reality and Accelerate Time perks (previously they were switched)
[*] [b]Sacred Hammer[/b] can no longer be cast with the Sacred Hammer buff (free cast)
[*] Fixed a bug that caused [b]Fury of the Earth[/b] autocasts from summoning buildings to occur at the current player position instead of the summoned building position
[/list]

[h2]Balance[/h2]

[list]
[*] Reduced the damage of small enemy tanks and fighter jets by 13% (the damage increase in the previous patch punished minion-based builds too much)
[*] Reduced the buff duration of [b]Power Amplifier[/b] (the satellite building) on friendly units and buildings by 30%, so it makes sense to destroy it first before unleashing more spells on enemy bases
[*] [b]Cleansing Rain[/b] has had its maximum stats reduced slightly due to the fact that it scales extremely well in the late game; to compensate for this change, the base stats have been increased to make the spell more useful even with small upgrades
[*] The mana cost of [b]Cleansing Rain[/b] has been increased significantly
[*] Increased late-game scaling of [b]Power Conduit's[/b] hit points, range, and damage properties
[*] Reduced the cooldown and mana cost of Rock Giant by 20%, and squashed its speed and durability stats to provide larger upgrades for fewer shards
[*] Reduced [b]Rock Giant's[/b] attack cooldown by 30% and increased its damage by 20%
[*] [b]Snake Pit[/b] has had its starting unit value increased to 2 (was 1) and its spawn frequency squashed to give more upgrades per shard
[*] Increased movement speed of most player units by 10-15%
[*] Powerful Spirits damage and hit points increased by 20%
[*] Added more upgrade steps to [b]Confusion [/b]duration
[*] The chance for Treants to spawn from [b]Shards Of Fortune[/b] (Gaia Power) has been greatly increased
[*] Increased chance of free cast ([b]Sacred Hammer[/b]) from [b]Shards Of Fortune[/b] (Gaia Power)
[*] [b]Gaia [/b]has increased her hit points and damage by 10% and summons 15% more spirits
[*] Removed the requirement that mana be below 80% to trigger [b]Howl of the Wolf[/b] (Gaia Power)
[*] [b]Timekeeper [/b]blessing has been changed to affect any non-basic spell (even one that is not on a cooldown), and its effect has been reduced slightly to prevent endless chain casts of long cooldown spells
[*] It is no longer possible to gain [b]Sacred Hammer [/b]buffs from spells cast with this buff
[*] Increased the hit points of enemy [b]Terraforming [/b]and [b]Destruction Sattelites[/b] by 20%
[*] Stargate hit points increased by 20%
[*] Slightly reduced the damage [b]Fire and Storm Troll Novas[/b] cast when spawning or dying.
[*] Upgraded version of[b] Fury Of the Earth[/b] now summons bigger exploding sheep (more damage and range) instead of Crystal golems
[*] [b]Fury Of The Earth[/b] summon chance is now influences by Swarming hive blessing
[*] To offset the above change the explosion range of exploding sheep has been reduced slightly
[*] Very slightly reduced the chance for [b]Sacred Hammer[/b] blessing to proc across all spells that have it
[/list]

[h2]Blessings[/h2]

[list]
[*] Reworked the [b]Persistence[/b] blessing - it now increases minion hitpoints and lifetime by 15/30/45/60/80/100%
[*] New blessing: [b]Ferocity[/b]- increases minion damage by 20/40/60/75/90/100%
[*] New blessing: [b]Leader of the pack[/b] - increases minion damage, hitpoints and lifetime by 10/20/30/38/45/50%
[/list]

[b]Note:[/b] The bonuses of the above blessings stack additively, not multiplicatively

[h2]Other[/h2]

[list]
[*] Renamed the spell "[b]Rock spike field[/b]" to "[b]Stone shard field[/b]" to emphasize it has nothing in common with "Rock spike"
[*] When the [b]Cast Spell[/b] perk casts a different spell than the original one the perk icon now shows that spell instead of the default "cast spell" icon
[*] All unit summoning buildings will now show the maximum amount of units active at once in the building info panel (Added this information to: Spectral Pond, Lava Nest, Snake Pit, Advanced factory, Star gate, Large star gate)
[*] Spiders summoned from [b]Webbed Menace[/b] are now spread around the crystal a bit further to prevent them all dying to a single lucky hit from enemies
[/list]

This update focused on bug fixes and bringing Urus' power up to par with Azzinoth and Nadea. The next patch will focus on doing the same for Zafira.

Peter

That is all for now. Hopefully you like the changes! There is a lot more in store (check out our [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/2207470/view/4145071432121302154?l=english]Roadmap[/url] ), so stay tuned!

notes.title: Titans update v 0.99
notes.notes:
[h1]Update v0.99[/h1]

[b]Great news![/b]

A major demo update has just landed on Steam, and you can look forward to trying out new spells and battling the Titans - large outpost commanders and generals of the machines! These bosses will now appear every time you deplete the resources of the machines, and you will only be granted victory after you defeat them.

Before we get into what exactly the Titans are and what you can expect from fighting them, let us summarize some of the other changes coming in this update:

[h2]Changelog[/h2]

[list]
[*] [b]spell autocasting[/b] - Spells that summon buildings are now marked with an hourglass icon. This means that you can turn on autocasting for these spells. Simply right-click on them in your spell bar and the game will automatically cast the spell whenever possible. We felt that this was a necessary feature, especially in the later stages of the game, as it became very tedious to go back and forth between the enemy base and your own base to summon buildings.
[*]  [b]New spell: Call of the Sea[/b] - Summon a large crab to fight for you that specializes in building destruction, but cannot attack enemy units. Protect it to get the most out of it!
[*] [b]New spell: Lava nest[/b] - a home of the Fire phoenix and a place where it respawns immediatelly after death.
[*] [b]New spell: Spectral pond[/b] - summons vicious crocodile spirits that explode upon contact with the enemy. They have low hit points, but compensate with a powerful attack over a wide area.
[*] Many bugfixes and small balance changes as always.
[/list]

[h1]Titans[/h1]

As stated above, the Titans are the generals of the enemy army and as such only partake in battle when really neccessary. When you attack a region, they are notified of your actions and start preparing to meet you in battle. You have 15 minutes until they arrive - however if you manage to deplete enemy resources before that happens, they will arrive immediatelly but slightly weakened. Otherwise they come in full strength to thwart your attack.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43691737/abf577f2d7a8f1f14caf9322cc874f50e9d6c4e6.png[/img]

Titans come in three flavors:

[list]
[*] [b]Outpost Commanders and Captains [/b]- the weakest and most common Titans. These are the ones you will fight at the low level outposts. They have strong attacks and a large health pool, but do not usually pose much of a threat.
[*] [b]Colossus [/b]- bigger and much stronger titans. There are several different types, each with different ways of waging war, from powerful Long Rage Lasers to summoning entire battalions of units, they are a formidable foe not to be underestimated.
[*] [b]Titans [/b]- the real titans. The strongest generals in the machine army, they can take massive amounts of damage and have many unique tricks up their sleeve. They are very difficult to defeat, but also very rare. You will only encounter them in later levels and will need the help of Gaia to stand a chance of defeating them. Be prepared!
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43691737/1009a949a3fbd99377cd7ad0ee17fdf0f72a8559.png[/img]

The level of the Titan is determined by the level of the outpost - low level outposts are led by weaker commanders and captains, while very high level outposts are led by a Titan. Sometimes you may even face a Titan or Colossus that has one or more Captains assisting him!

[b]You can try out these bosses in the demo.[/b] You will be able to encounter Commanders and Captains, and maybe a Colossus or two. Let us know what you think! This is a new feature and we will be carefully balancing their strength and adding new features over time until release.

[h1]What is next?[/h1]

We plan to update the demo frequently, so rest assured any bugs will be fixed eventually. In the meantime, we will continue to work hard on the game, taking all of your feedback to heart!

Thanks,
Peter

notes.title: Extended demo update v0.97
notes.notes:
[h1]Update v0.97[/h1]

Exciting news! A large demo update has just landed on Steam and you can look forward to progressing a little bit further in the campaign and also try new Gaia powers!

Before you do that, we invite you to join our Discord server where you can give us feedback or just ask questions. This stuff is still new to us, so please be patient while we figure it all out.

[b]Join here: [/b]https://discord.gg/kyYPRA7hNx


[h1]Changelog[/h1]

[h2]Extended demo[/h2]

[list]
[*] you can now progress up to level [b]12[/b] in the campaign
[*] after defeating a level 9 or higher enemy you will be able to activate one of three Gaia powers: [b]Shards of Fortune, Solar Flare or Diamond Core[/b]
[/list]

[h2]Bugfixes[/h2]

[list]
[*] Fixed a bug that allowed Immortal Phoenix to be cast on buildings - this ability now needs to be activated via spell upgrades
[*] Fixed missing description of one of Immortal Phoenix properties
[*] Fixed a bug that caused shields or antimagic zones to be generated away from enemy outposts, thus being useless
[*] Fixed a bug that caused Lion spirit to spawn underwater
[*] Fixed a bug that made it impossible to interact with the Lion spirit in many cases
[*] Minimap now retains its size between regions and playthroughs
[*] Fixed a bug where Star gate had the wrong building definition assigned meaning its properties were incorrectly set (hitpoints etc.)
[*] Added missing Star gate description
[*] Fixed a bug causing capital ships to not shoot from their main weapons
[*] Fixed a bug that caused healthbars to appear for a split second on newly created buildings before their construction started
[*] Fixed damage not working at all in the Spike Field spell
[/list]

[h2]Core[/h2]

[list]
[*] Extended the length of the campaign to 40 regions (was 35) - there likely won't be any more extensions to the regular campaign but stay tuned for our new endgame plans
[*] Reworked random events spawning in such a way that it allows for more variety and bigger impact of the events
[*] Added several new events and created very powerful variants of existing ones (these will be used very rarely, but will have major impact) - examples: Empowered Star Gate (spawning stronger units)
[*] Improved the way enemy builder drones select what to build first - previously on large maps with many islands drones would spend way too much time travelling back and forth which unintentionally reduced the difficulty of the region greatly
[*] Increased the speed of builder drones by 20%
[*] Added a tooltip explaining the minimap can be used for fast travel
[*] Added a new building: Advanced Star Gate which summons stronger enemy units (Heavy tank and Artillery)
[*] Added several new events using the new Advanced Star Gate building
[*] Increased the minimum amount of land a region must have to prevent bad maps from being created where there is almost nowhere to build
[/list]

[h2]Balance[/h2]

[list]
[*] Increased attack power and hitpoints of enemies in levels 30-35 by 3%
[*] Greatly improved the power and speed of Deep sea crab but slightly reduced it's lifetime
[*] Increased the strength of Raven Thief blessing by 20%
[*] Reduced the strength of Golden Acorn and Unstable Energy blessings by 10% and 25% respectively
[*] Reduced the strength of Solar Flare (Gaia power) by a small amount in high upgrade levels as it became too powerful there
[*] Reduced the base amount of corruption bombs (Bomber, Capital ship, Capital fighter, Mobile Artillery) and corruption beams (Corruption satellite) do by 30-40% but made the final amount applied scale with enemy level so that the corruption spread is relevant in all levels (previously, this amount was flat regardless of enemy level, so it made these special units be much more deadly early on but quite weak in later stages of the game)

[*] Improved the visual appearance of Crystal Spire and reduced it's cooldown from 50 seconds to 30 seconds
[*] Reduced the cost of Stormbreakers hammer by 40%
[*] Reduced the cooldown of Builders Hammer by 20% but increased it's cost by 100%
[*] Reduced the chance to cast stronger spells for all elemental echo's and increased the number of levels for this property to make it a bit more expensive
[/list]

[h2]Powers[/h2]

[list]
[*] Fixed "Shards Of Fortune" Gaia power not triggering in many cases
[/list]

[h2]Other[/h2]

[list]
[*] Added tips to the loading screen explaining random events in more detail
[*] Improved visual appearance of gaia power indicators
[/list]

[h1]What is next?[/h1]

We plan to update the demo frequently, so rest assured any bugs will be fixed eventually. In the meantime, we will continue to work hard on the game, taking all of your feedback to heart!

Thanks,
Peter

notes.title: Big game update v0.96

[*] reduced hitpoints of enemy factories by 20%

[*] increased the range of Confusion spell from 25 to 30 and made it castable in antimagic zones but slightly reduced initial duration and increased cooldown
[*] added corruption removal capability to the Confusion spell
[*] increased the chance stronger spiders will be spawned by Gaia's power "Webbed Menace"
[*] increased the base range of Lava fissure from 300 to 500
[*] added AOE damage to Vacuum and Whirlpool spells (must be activated via an upgrade)
[*] added the ability for Storm Pillar to summon additional pillars (must be activated via an upgrade)
[*] added frequency improvement property to Builder's Hammer, allowing the players to improve attacking speed of Lava Fissure and Storm Pillar, healing speed of Tree of Life and spawning speed of Spirit Den
[*] most spirit related blessings have been updated to reflect the new spirit system
[*] added four new spells: Immortal Phoenix, Regrowth, Stormbreaker's hammer and Crystal cave
[*] added four new blessings: Swarming hive, Fleeing rats, Golden acorn, Unstable energy
[*] reduced the overall scaling of volcano because it was way too powerful at high upgrade levels
[*] reduced lifetime and damage scaling of Rock Giant in high levels
[*] reduced damage scaling of Tornado at higher levels but added it the ability to hit flying targets
[*] Void Beam can now hit also flying targets
[*] Howl of the Wolf gaia power now applies to units summoned when bellow 80% mana (was above 20% mana)
[/list]

[h2]Units[/h2]

[list]
[*] Added a new machine unit: Mobile artillery, a large heavy vehicle capable of spreading corruption and long range attacks
[*] Slightly decreased the size of capital ships
[*] Addew two new units that can join the player: Wind and Earth spirit
[*] Decreased the corruption output of Corruption Satellite by 20%
[/list]

[h2]Buildings[/h2]

[list]
[*] Added a new building: Crystal cave that summons Crystal golems when destroyed
[*] Decreased the corruption output bonus of large alien drill by 16%
[*] Increased the hitpoints of Tree of life by 30%
[/list]

[h2]Campaign[/h2]

[list]
[*] increased the number of regions in the campaign from 30 to 35, reduced attack/hitpoints scaling for machines above level 30
[*] increased corruption cap from 7000 to 10000
[*] updated achievements for winning with fewest attacked regions from 10, 14, 18 to 12, 16, 20
[*] unlocking spells and blessings is now done after every region, not just at the end of a run, allowing for immediate appearance of unlocked spells and blessings as rewards
[*] at the end of the campaign, additional essences of nature are rewarded to the player regardless of whether they won or not - the amount is based on how far the player progressed
[/list]

[h2]Other[/h2]

[list]
[*] cosmetic change: enemy tanks are now aiming their cannons at the target continuously, not just when they fire
[*] improved the description of several spell properties so that is easier to understand what they do
[*] added indicators of power, critical chance and corruption resistance to the main in-game UI (top panel)
[/list]

[h1]What is next?[/h1]

We plan to update the demo frequently, so rest assured any bugs will be fixed eventually. In the meantime, we will continue to work hard on the game, taking all of your feedback to heart!

Thanks,
Peter

notes.title: Release date announcement
notes.notes:
Hi all,

We have some exciting news to share with you today: the release date for Gods Agains Machines has been set! We are looking forward to you checking out the game.

[h2]Release date[/h2]

[b]Worldwide release date:[/b] 23th February 2024

For specific times check out this short list:

[list]
[*] [b]Europe:[/b] 10am Central European Time
[*] [b]US[/b]: 1am Pacific, 4am Eastern
[*] [b]Asia:[/b] 5m Tokyo Time
[/list]

[h2]Major demo update[/h2]

In preparation for the Steam Next Fest starting this Monday, October 9th, we have prepared a major update to the demo. This update adds tons of new features, spells and even allows you to play as Nadea, the water goddess and progress in the campaign a bit further than previously possible! Check out the full list of all major changes bellow:

[h3]Core[/h3]

[list]
[*] Greatly expandend meta progression with the Gaia Powers system (2 core powers available in the demo)
[*] Revised random events in the game - they are now tied to corruption and resource levels, thus making them more deterministic
[*] Random events are now much more powerful and can turn the tide of battle in either direction
[*] Many new events added - alien satellites, celestial focus etc.
[*] Added a few more tutorials and streamlined the existing ones
[*] Added several settings regarding Gaia's voice, camera shake intensity, health bars etc.
[*] New types of minions (golems, sheep, phoenix...) and machines (advanced tank, satellite, battlecruiser...)
[*] Rebalanced the difficulty of the regions at the beginning of the campaign to give players a bit more challenge (previously they were way too easy and thus boring)
[*] Changed Urus' core power (we completely removed the age aspect of buildings and minions, and instead let Urus summon more units when he casts certain types of spells)
[/list]

[h3]Progression[/h3]

[list]
[*] Gaia powers meta progression - earn essences of life to upgrade the powers of Gaia. These carry over between playthroughs and can become extremely powerful when fully upgraded, thus allowing you to progress faster and further.
[*] Several spells are now locked to a specific god, further reinforcing each god's identity
[*] The progression of each god has been improved to make unlocking new spells more fun and rewarding (very powerful spells are now at the end of the progression path, such as the spell Eclipse)
[/list]

[h3]Spells & Blessings[/h3]

[list]
[*] Over two dozen new spells, with about half available in the demo as well, some examples include: Shatter, Tornado, Builder's hammer, Clone Creature, Tree of life, Call spirit etc.
[*] Over twenty new blessings and curses, most of which are also available in the demo
[*] A lot of balance changes to most spells and blessings to make upgrades more impactful while keeping the game reasonably challenging
[/list]

[h3]UI[/h3]

[list]
[*] Added completely new progression UI (both Gaia powers progression and also progression paths for each god)
[*] Improved spellbook to be able to handle both regular spells and also Gaia powers
[*] Added UI indicators in the main game view to better inform the player about special events or situations they need to pay attention to
[*] Reworked the way miracles are shown in the main game's UI
[*] Improved the way rewards are displayed and offered (mostly bugs related to too long descriptions or missing rewards)
[/list]

[h2]Conclusion[/h2]

We hope you like the changes we made and would love to hear your feedback! Let us know what you think in the comments or on our forums, and be sure to report any issues you encounter so we can fix them before our launch in less than 6 weeks!

Thank you very much,
Peter from Silver Eye Studios

notes.title: Update v0.74
notes.notes:
[h1]Update v0.74[/h1]

Based on feedback we received after our demo's launch we implemented a plethora of changes, some small and some quite substantial. Here is a list of the most important ones:

[h2]Campaign[/h2]

[list]
[*] Increased the number of [b]power shards[/b] received at the start of the game from 2 to 8
[*] The machines can now use the [b]Shield [/b]and [b]Refinery [/b]buildings sooner to give more variety and challenge at the start of the game, but their utility is more limited compared to later levels
[*] Considerably increased [b]power shard[/b] amount when skipping regions
[*] Spell rewards - starting from the third spell reward player element is no longer prioritized by 2 choices but by just one thus allowing for larger variety in builds
[*] Enemy builders will now have a harder time building stuff when the corruption is high (slower build speed), which should give players a bit more time to deal with the enemy
[*] Reduced the amount of extra corruption (bonus for nearby residential buildings) that is generated by terraformers by 50% to offset the change above
[/list]

[h2]Spells[/h2]

[list]
[*] [b]Many spells[/b] received additional audiovisual cues and effects to make casting them more fun
[*] [b]All spells[/b] now have a targeting indicator (previously only some spells had it)
[*] [b]Combustion[/b] - increased damage by 30%
[*] [b]Wildfire[/b] - increased duration by 25%
[*] [b]Rock giant[/b] - initial attack cooldown has been removed so that the giant can attack immediatelly after spawning
[*] [b]Fire eater[/b] - fixed a bug that prevented this spell from working properly in most cases
[*] [b]Rejuvenation[/b] - fixed a bug that caused no effects to be shown when the spell was cast
[*] [b]Cleansing rain[/b] - increased the amount of corruption that is cleansed and fixed tooltip for stun (extra effect that can be unlocked)
[*] Spells that generate mana or miracles will now show the generated amount on screen
[*] Increased base mana regeneration by 20%
[/list]

[h2]User Interface[/h2]

[list]
[*] [b]World screen[/b] - added the ability to open the game menu with the Escape key
[*] [b]World screen[/b] - menu buttons are now a bit larger
[*] [b]Spirit screen[/b] - added missing icons for some rewards
[*] [b]Spell properties[/b] - added highlight for upgraded properties
[/list]

[h2]Controls[/h2]

[list]
[*] The button for casting spells can now be held for continuous casting
[/list]

[h2]Other[/h2]

[list]
[*] [b]Settings[/b] - fixed a bug that prevented audio volume to be correctly applied when loading settings
[*] [b]Buildings[/b]- enemy buildings can now be targeted and damaged during construction but have a 90% damage reduction during that phase
[*] Fixed a bug that sometimes caused weird sound artifacts when the player moved fast over the map
[*] Fixed a rare bug that could lead to crash when the moving target of a spell died before the spell finished casting
[/list]

[h2]What is next?[/h2]

We still plan to update the demo as we find bugs, but these will mostly be minor updates. In the meantime, we will continue to work hard on the game, taking all of your feedback to heart.

In a future post, we will reveal some of the much bigger changes coming to the game - such as a new, much deeper progression system centered around working with Gaia, some major changes to how we distribute rewards, as well as major improvements to the AI, new enemy types, random events, and more!

Thanks,
Peter
